text: **dsh-ponytail-skills**（DSH 插件，通用客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 添加精简编码技能。它在 host 层向 `ctx.skills` 注册提供者，扫描技能目录并按需返回内容。六项技能涵盖 YAGNI 编码模式、过度工程评审与全仓审计、简化债务台账、基准收益展示和使用速查。适合希望编码 agent 优先复用代码、标准库和原生能力，并减少不必要复杂度的开发者。无需 API key 或额外配置；安装后重启 profile 即可使用。

**dsh-ponytail-skills** adds six prompt skills to DSH through its host skill provider. They guide YAGNI coding, over-engineering reviews and audits, track simplification notes, show benchmark figures, and explain usage. No API key or extra configuration is needed.
我想让编码 agent 默认先考虑 YAGNI 和最简单可行的实现。
帮我检查这段改动有没有不必要的抽象、依赖或重复代码。
想对整个代码仓库做一次过度工程审计，并按可删减收益排序。
有没有办法把代码里标记的简化和待办注释整理成债务清单？
我想快速查看精简编码模式有哪些强度、技能和触发方式。
Can my coding assistant prefer YAGNI, reuse, and the smallest working change?
Review my diff only for over-engineering and suggest what to remove.
Audit an entire repository and rank its biggest simplification opportunities.
**dsh-ponytail-skills** 的编码模式功能：引导 agent 按 YAGNI、复用、标准库和原生能力寻找精简方案。加载 `ponytail` 技能使用，可选择 lite、full 或 ultra 强度。
**dsh-ponytail-skills** 的变更评审功能：只查找过度工程、冗余依赖和可删除复杂度，按单行发现给出位置与替代建议。调用 `ponytail-review`，不会直接应用修改。
**dsh-ponytail-skills** 的仓库审计功能：扫描整个代码库并按最大删减收益排序，指出可删除、简化或替换的内容。调用 `ponytail-audit` 生成一次性报告，不会修改仓库。
**dsh-ponytail-skills** 的债务台账功能：汇总代码中 `ponytail:` 注释标记的简化决定，记录限制和升级触发条件。通过 `ponytail-debt` 技能生成只读报告。
**dsh-ponytail-skills** 的收益记分牌功能：展示已发布基准测试的代码量、成本和速度中位数区间，并说明这些数据不是当前仓库的实测结果。调用 `ponytail-gain` 查看。
**dsh-ponytail-skills** 的帮助速查功能：列出三档模式、六个技能、触发方式和停用方法。调用 `ponytail-help` 显示参考卡，不改变模式。

| `ponytail-review` | 只针对过度工程的代码评审:每行一个发现(位置、删什么、用什么替代) |

dsh-ponytail-skills README · 工作原理：- **Bundle 层** —— `cordis.patch.yml` 在 dsh-base 层插入插件行,后续层可按 id 定位。
- **提供者** —— `lib/index.js` 调用 `ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)`:扫描
  `skills/` 目录,从 YAML frontmatter 解析 `name`/`description` 并返回完整技能
  定义,`resourceBase` 指向技能目录。
- **零运行时依赖** —— 只使用 Node 内置模块。

dsh-ponytail-skills README · 移植说明(对比上游)：- **技能文件与上游完全一致(verbatim)**:包括 `description: >` 折叠多行
  frontmatter——提供者(`lib/index.js`)原生解析折叠标量(按 YAML 语义以
  单空格连接),无需任何改写。
- `argument-hint`、`license` 等元数据原样透传。
- 调用语义:全部模型/用户可调用(上游未设 `disable-model-invocation`)。

Ponytail, the lazy senior dev mode, for the **DeepSeek Harness (DSH)** — 6
skills adapted from [DietrichGebert/ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)
(the ~76k⭐ "laziest solution that actually works" coding style).

dsh-ponytail-skills README · dsh-ponytail：The plugin registers a skill provider on the **host layer** of the `ctx.skills`
registry. The 6 skills ship inside the package (`skills/<name>/SKILL.md`); no
user configuration needed.

> **Unofficial port**: skill content adapted from
> [DietrichGebert/ponytail](https://github.com/DietrichGebert/ponytail)
> (MIT, © DietrichGebert).

dsh-ponytail-skills README · Quick start：Tell the agent **"use ponytail mode for this code"**, or let it adopt the style
on its own while coding: YAGNI → reuse existing code → standard library →
native platform features → one line → minimal code. Intensity levels:
`lite` / `full` (default) / `ultra`; `"stop ponytail"` exits the mode.

dsh-ponytail-skills README · Skills：| Skill | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `ponytail` | Core mode: forces the laziest working solution — YAGNI → stdlib → native → one line → minimum. lite / full (default) / ultra |
| `ponytail-review` | Code review focused exclusively on over-engineering: one line per finding (location, what to cut, what replaces it) |
| `ponytail-audit` | Whole-repo over-engineering audit (repo-wide ponytail-review): ranked list, biggest cut first |
| `ponytail-debt` | Harvest every `ponytail:` comment into a debt ledger so deferrals don't rot into "later means never" |
| `ponytail-gain` | Show ponytail's measured impact as a compact scoreboard (benchmark medians) |
| `ponytail-help` | Quick-reference card for all modes, skills and commands |

dsh-ponytail-skills README · publishes as dsh-ponytail-skills)：dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ponytail-skills
dsh-ponytail-skills README · GitHub：dsh plugin --profile web add github:gongyijie85/dsh-ponytail

dsh-ponytail-skills README · Local folder (development)：dsh plugin --profile web add D:\plugins\dsh-ponytail
```

Restart the profile (`dsh web`) — the skills then load with the `skill` tool.

dsh-ponytail-skills README · How it works：- **Bundle layer** — `cordis.patch.yml` inserts a plugin row over the dsh-base
  layer; later layers can address it by id.
- **Provider** — `lib/index.js` calls `ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)`:
  scans `skills/`, parses `name`/`description` from YAML frontmatter, returns
  full skill definitions with `resourceBase` pointing at each skill directory.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — Node built-ins only.

dsh-ponytail-skills README · Adaptation notes (vs upstream)：- **Flattened descriptions**: upstream's folded `description: >` multi-line
  frontmatter was flattened to single lines — the DSH discovery parser reads
  scalar values only.
- Skill bodies unchanged (pure prompts, no harness-specific references);
  `argument-hint`, `license` and other metadata pass through verbatim.
- Invocation: all skills are model+user invocable (upstream sets no
  `disable-model-invocation`).
